title: UI says 'Saved' when nothing was saved (storage blocked or save failed)
detail: shell.ts:69/245 flashes the Saved chip on every graph event unconditionally, and app.ts:593 toasts 'Stored ... Saved.'. main.ts:47 sets store=null when localStorage is blocked (Safari private, disabled storage): no autosave starts and no warning appears, yet the user sees 'Saved' and loses everything on reload. After a quota failure the error toast appears, but so does Saved on the next edit. Fix: add an onSaved callback to startAutosave's options (or a status the shell reads) and drive the chip from real setItem success. When storage() returns null, show a persistent 'This browser won't keep your memory; export to save' toast and drop 'Saved.' from the store toast.

title: Imported perspective.accent is unvalidated and interpolated into style attributes (CSS injection, external beacon)
detail: validateDoc only checks that accent is text. lensColor (ui/scene.ts:12) returns it raw, and topbar.ts:52 and inspector.ts:74 build style='--c:${accent}'. An accent like 'red;background-image:url(https://host/x)' validates (verified with a probe script), so opening a shared file makes a network request and restyles chrome. It cannot run script, but it is hostile input crossing a trust boundary. Fix: in validateDoc and graph #checkPerspective, require /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/ (or a small CSS colour whitelist), and set colours through style.setProperty('--c', v) instead of string-built style attributes.

title: Import replaces the whole memory with no confirm, no undo and no export-first
detail: app.importText (app.ts:670) calls graph.load directly. onReset clears the undo stack, and autosave overwrites the stored copy 400 ms later. Reset-to-seed (app.ts:677) guards the same destructive replace with a confirm and an 'Export first' choice; import does not. One mis-picked file destroys the user's stored things. Fix: reuse the resetToSeed confirm ('Replace your memory with <file>? Your N stored things will be gone unless you export first.' with Cancel / Export first / Replace) after validation succeeds and before load.

title: Unreadable autosave is silently overwritten on the next change
detail: When loadSaved fails validation (for example a future-version file or a partial write), the seed is shown and the next edit overwrites constellation.memory.v1. The only recovery is a 12 s toast, and its advice to 'export first' exports the seed, not the broken copy. Fix: before starting autosave, copy the raw text to 'constellation.memory.v1.unreadable' (or offer a 'Download the saved copy' action that exports the raw stored string), and word the toast to match.

title: Autosave never flushes on page hide; edits in the last 400 ms are lost
detail: startAutosave returns a flush-and-stop function, but main.ts discards it and registers no pagehide/visibilitychange handler. Storing a thing and closing the tab (or a mobile background kill) within the debounce loses the edit, even though the UI already said 'Saved'. Fix: keep the returned function and call it on pagehide and on visibilitychange to hidden (then restart autosave if the page stays alive), or add a flush() to the autosave API.

title: Undo of Delete drops the node's units (and created time)
detail: nodeCopy copies id/label/kind/value/facets/tags/notes/file/pathway but not units, so deleting Temperature and pressing Undo brings it back without '°C'. Traces and the inspector then show bare numbers, and the change persists through autosave. Fix: include units: n.units. Better, snapshot the whole frozen node (canonical copy) and restore it through a graph-level restore so created/updated survive too.

title: learnShortcut returns an existing lens-hidden shortcut; UI claims 'learned' and Undo deletes the pre-existing line
detail: The idempotency check ignores relation.perspectives. Repro (probe script): add a shortcut road-a<->road-z with perspectives ['physicist']. Under cook, learn on the 3-hop route returns that hidden relation; cook still routes 3 hops, the toast says 'Next time it's one hop', and app.ts:399 registers an Undo that removes the user's existing physicist-only line. Fix: treat a shortcut as existing only if it is visible in the route's lens (pass the perspective via options), or widen it with updateRelation(perspectives: undefined). In app.learn, register an undo only when the relation was newly created.

title: Huge numeric literals evaluate to Infinity, bypassing the finite() guard
detail: Number('9'.repeat(400)) is Infinity. evaluate() returns literals without finite(), so 'assign x <- 999…' stores Infinity (verified) and later prints 'Infinity'. Fix: in the tokenizer, if !Number.isFinite(value), fail('That number is too large', pos).

title: maxSteps NaN/Infinity disables the step guard
detail: Math.max(1, Math.floor(NaN)) is NaN, so 'steps.length >= NaN' is never true and a while-true pathway loops forever. Infinity behaves the same way. No caller passes either today (the UI uses the default 500), but this is the safety guard. Fix: const m = Number(options?.maxSteps); const maxSteps = Number.isFinite(m) ? clamp(floor(m), 1, 100000) : 500.

title: Ids named __proto__ silently lose positions/facets on load (plain-object canon copies)
detail: validateDoc accepts node and perspective id '__proto__'. canonPerspective/canonFacets/canonUnits write into {} literals, so pos['__proto__']=vec sets the prototype instead of an own key. A probe import shows the position gone, which breaks the export to import deep-equal promise. There is no global pollution. Fix: reject reserved ids (isReservedName) in validateDoc and graph checks, or build canon maps with Object.create(null) or Object.fromEntries.

title: SpriteLayer/EdgeLayer grow mid-batch without copying already-pushed data
detail: ensure() is called from push() and allocates fresh zeroed arrays (layers.ts:278-289 and 448-461), discarding the instances pushed earlier in the frame. LiteLineLayer.ensure (574-579) copies correctly. The result is a one-frame flicker of all lines or sprites whenever the count crosses 64/128/256…, for example after a store or link. Fix: copy the old arrays into the new ones, as LiteLineLayer does, or size from the known count in begin(n).

title: Seed-specific copy and magic label in product code
detail: Any imported memory's featured route is offered as 'Try the Long Road: A -> Z', and scene.ts:110 picks the scene root with findByLabel('Memory'). Both are seed knowledge leaking into the generic UI. Fix: say 'Try the featured route: A -> Z' (or add an optional meta.featured.route.label), and make the root explicit (meta.featured.root or highest-degree node).

title: Overlay text-width cache grows without bound
detail: widths is keyed by kind+text and is cleared only on font load. Condition chips and loop badges create new strings on every step of every run, so a long session accumulates entries forever. Fix: cap it (clear when size > 2000) or use a small LRU.

title: Find route and search never reframe the camera; results play off-screen
where: F7 / F11 · 1024 and 1440 · after any select or pathway run
detail: Now: after selecting Temperature (camera at d=70) then R → Try the Long Road, the 25-vs-3 race happens off-screen; only O–P are visible (F7-1024). Searching 'boil' after a pathway run lights nothing in view (F11-1440). Definition lines 3 and 5 visibly fail on an ordinary path. Should be: on Find route, fly 900 ms inout to fit both trails' bounding sphere ×1.15 inside the free canvas (panel insets); on search, if fewer than half the depth ≤1 nodes are on screen, fit them the same way. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F7-1024.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F11-1440.jpg (vs bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F11-fresh-400.jpg)

Spec §7 puts Long Road letters above visible degree in label priority. Should be: letters rank above degree (cap 40 is met by dropping low-degree files/vars); during a route, A, Z and every shortest-path waypoint are forced labels (Manrope 500 11 px, ink, 6 px off the bead). Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F1-1440.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F7-1440.jpg

title: The shortcut does not cut across the ring: A and Z are neighbours, chord hugs the bottom
detail: Now: A (709,851) and Z (584,794) sit 137 px apart at F1; the 3-hop path zig-zags A→F→X→Z along the bottom third and the learned A–Z line is ~140 px long, so '25 hops → 1 hop' looks trivial and the X→Z hop overlaps the chain near Y. Spec F6: the shortcut crosses the empty centre. Should be: open the ring into a horseshoe/spiral so A and Z are ≥ 60% of the ring diameter apart and the A–Z chord passes through the centre (designer + layout). Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F7-1440.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F8-1440.jpg

detail: Now: toast spans x558–880 y826–876 and covers the A end of the new A–Z line (A at 887,849) at the signature moment; at F1 the hint pill covers A and B (709,851 / 751,860). Should be: default fit leaves ≥ 96 px clear above the viewport bottom (shift target so the ring's lowest bead sits ≤ 780 at 900 h); on Learn, ease the view so the line midpoint sits ≥ 120 px above the toast top, or move toasts to top-centre 16 px under the top bar. title: Undo of Learn leaves the drawer stale and the reverse draw is ~120 ms, not 300
detail: Now: after Undo the stats read 100 lines but the drawer still says '1 hop A → Z', '25 hops → 1 hop · 96% shorter' and Learn stays disabled ('Already one hop'); at +100 ms only a ~35 px stub of the line remains, gone by +200 (polish 13). Should be: recompute the route on undo (back to 3 hops, Learn enabled); reverse draw 300 ms inout from Z to A. Copy: 'Undone: Learned A ↔ Z.' → 'Forgot the shortcut A ↔ Z.' Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/U-undo-0.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/U-undo-100.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/U-undo-200.jpg

title: Lens colour is not visible in the sky; halos read neutral grey
detail: Now: halo annulus around Kelvin under Cook averages RGB (37,34,33), chroma ≈ 4/255; Cook and Physicist skies differ only by chips, so 'the colour of the sky tells you whose mind' fails. Should be: halo tint 25% → 55% lens, halo peak alpha +40%, so an annulus samples ≥ 20/255 chroma toward the lens hue; verify F1 amber vs F5 ice side by side. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F1-1440.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F5-retracted-4000.jpg

title: Disagreement window shows 21 bordered chips that crowd the Heat cluster and cannot be attributed
detail: Now: 21 chips at F5 incl. 30-char file facets ('the paper with the soup on it'), boxed mono with borders (HUD look, anti-goal), overlapping labels around Room/Heat/Kelvin; mid-morph (t=480) chips stack on each other. Which chip belongs to Temperature is guesswork. Should be: chips at the tether end only, max 16 chars + ellipsis, no border (text on rgba(0,0,0,.6) 4 px radius plate), run chips through the label declutter, and expand at most 8 disagreeing nodes ranked by screen centrality (all on hover/select or D). Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F5-1440.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/M-burst-0480.jpg

title: Pathway glyphs collapse into solid mint discs on a shifting subset of nodes
detail: Now: the same pathway nodes render as glyphs in one frame and as 20–36 px filled mint discs in another (assign stirs ← 0, end nodes, if t > Safe To Touch: compare bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F5-1440.jpg with bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F4-reduced-300.jpg; P2/P3 in bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F10-1440.jpg). The flowchart loses its = / ◇ / ring vocabulary. Should be: clamp glyph brightness so the SDF interior never saturates (max core alpha .85 inside the glyph), and keep the glyph visible in visited/lit states (lit = ring 1.3×, not fill).

title: Line breaks split numbers from units and orphan route endpoints
where: F9/F10 drawer trace · F7-1024 route row
detail: Now: '20 / °C', '373 / K' break across lines in the trace and result; at 1024 the route row wraps 'A → B → C → … → X → Y →' / 'Z' (polish 11). Should be: U+00A0 between value and unit in the formatter; U+00A0 before each '→' in route rows with white-space:nowrap on the last two hops; trace lines wrap only at ' · '. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F9-1440.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F10-1440.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F7-1024.jpg

title: Canvas runs under the top bar; F9 read target and chip sit behind the search field
detail: Now: at F9 Boiling Point and its '100 °C' chip render at y≈20–55 under the search field; at F10 variable diamonds sit behind the lens switcher. Should be: top scrim linear-gradient #000 .85 → 0 over 0–72 px, and the pathway fit includes its read targets inside an inset of top 72 px (so the read spark and value chip are in frame). Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F9-1440.jpg, bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F10-1440.jpg

title: New node is born on top of its link target
detail: Now: Tea's ring sits ~19 px from Temperature's at the default view and the two rings overlap; it reads as a blemish, not a birth. Should be: birth distance 8 u → max(14 u, 2.5·(r_target + r_new)) at the emptiest of 8 seeded sectors (polish 21). Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F12-1440.jpg

detail: Now: the verdict is a solid #E6FF6E pill, the real primary 'Learn shortcut A → Z' is an olive outline; the drawer close ✕ sits at x=366, outside the panel edge (~355). 'Try the Long Road' chip is 2 px under the From input and 4 px above Find route. detail: Now: at d=70 concept cores hit the 18 px clamp as solid discs (Soup, Pot, Heat) and look like pearls, not stars. Should be: core 0.6r with gaussian falloff past 0.4r, so at 18 px only a 7 px hot centre is solid. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-constellation/evidence/critic/F3-1440.jpg
